general.title: OMIX GSVA
general.instructions: Calculate sample-level pathway enrichment scores from normalized continuous expression. Provide three inputs: normalized expression, matching sample metadata, and an approved long-format pathway database. Leave a file selector blank only when the attached assets contain exactly one unambiguous candidate for that role. Raw counts are not supported.

categories.name: Inputs
categories.description: Required expression, metadata, and pathway membership tables

categories.name: Samples and Pathways
categories.description: Identifiers, species, samples, and pathway collections

categories.name: GSVA Method
categories.description: Scoring method and gene-set size controls

categories.name: Advanced
categories.description: Gene updating, warnings, delimiter, and output dimensions

parameters.name: Normalized Expression File
parameters.description: Normalized continuous gene-by-sample CSV, TSV, or TXT. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible table under /data.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.description: Matching sample metadata CSV, TSV, or TXT. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible table under /data.

parameters.name: Pathway Database File
parameters.description: Approved long membership table containing collection, gene_set_name, gene_symbol, and species. Leave blank to discover one compatible attached asset.

parameters.name: Gene Column
parameters.description: Gene identifier column in normalized expression.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.description: Sample identifier column in sample metadata.

parameters.name: Samples to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated sample IDs. Leave blank to use matching metadata samples in metadata order.

parameters.name: Expression Species
parameters.description: Species of gene identifiers in normalized expression.

parameters.name: Database Species
parameters.description: Species to select from a standard pathway database.

parameters.name: Collections to Include
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact collection names from the pathway database.

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Database
parameters.description: Use Custom Species instead of Database Species when selecting pathway rows.

parameters.name: Custom Species
parameters.description: Species to select when Custom Pathway Database is true.

parameters.name: Minimum Gene-set Size
parameters.description: Minimum number of overlapping genes required for a gene set.

parameters.name: Maximum Gene-set Size
parameters.description: Maximum number of overlapping genes allowed for a gene set.

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.description: Update expression and gene-set symbols with l2psupp before scoring.

parameters.name: Warning Level
parameters.description: R warning option; -1 suppresses warnings and 0 displays them.

parameters.name: Input Delimiter
parameters.description: Delimiter shared by all three inputs. Use \t for TSV/TXT or comma for CSV.
